Sounds: the connecting and the cutting hamza
Kat‘ hemzesi her zaman okunur; vasl hemzesi yalnızca başta okunur.
The cutting hamza is always pronounced; the connecting hamza is pronounced only at the beginning.
Kat‘ hemzesi (أ / إ) söze başta da ortada da okunur. Vasl hemzesi (ا) yalnızca başta okunur; önüne bir kelime gelince okunmaz.
The cutting hamza (أ / إ) is pronounced both at the beginning of speech and in the middle. The connecting hamza (ا) is pronounced only at the beginning; it is not pronounced when a word precedes it.
Bu dersin asıl kaydı yok; kelimeler ve cümleler gömülü okunuşla çalar.
There is no original recording for this lesson; the words and sentences play with the embedded reading.
Vasl hemzesi taşıyan kelimelerde baştaki hemze ortada okunmaz (ve-ğfir, fe-nsurnâ); kat‘ hemzesi her durumda okunur (ve-ebsir).
In words with a connecting hamza, the initial hamza is not pronounced in the middle (wa-ghfir, fa-nsurnā); the cutting hamza is always pronounced (wa-absir).

كانَ is a defective past verb; it enters the nominal sentence: it leaves the subject nominative (the noun of كانَ) and makes the predicate accusative (the predicate of كانَ). Mâzî fiile أ، ن، ي، ت eklenince muzâri olur (أَنَيْتُ).
Adding أ، ن، ي، ت to a past verb makes it imperfect (أَنَيْتُ).
Muzâraat harfleri dörttür: أ (ben), ن (biz), ي (o — erkek), ت (sen / o — kadın). Mâzî fiilin başına gelerek onu muzâri yapar. Kolay hatırlamak için: أَنَيْتُ.
The letters of the imperfect are four: أ (I), ن (we), ي (he), ت (you / she). They come at the beginning of the past verb and make it imperfect. To remember them easily: أَنَيْتُ.

The noun that describes the one before it and agrees with it in case.
Na‘t ya da sıfat, öncesindeki ismi (men‘ût) niteleyen ve i‘râbta ona uyan isimdir. Ayrıca belirlilik (ال), cinsiyet ve sayıda da ona uyar: طالِبَةٌ جَديدَةٌ، اللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ.

The naʿt or adjective is the noun that describes the noun before it (manʿūt) and agrees with it in case. It also agrees with it in definiteness (ال), gender and number: طالِبَةٌ جَديدَةٌ، اللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ.

Write the verse in your notebook in naskh script.
﴿هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ﴾ (التوبة: ٣٣) — Dinini bütün dinlere üstün kılmak için Resûlünü hidayet ve hak din ile gönderen O’dur.

﴿هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ﴾ (التوبة: ٣٣) — It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to make it prevail over all religion.

Vasl hemzesi okunsun okunmasın, harekesi kesra, fetha ya da ötre olsun, üzerine hemze konmadan yalnızca elif (ا) olarak yazılır: اسْم (إسم değil), امْرَأَة, ادْخُلْ (أُدْخُلْ değil). Lâm-ı cerden sonra ال’nin elifi yazılmaz: لِلَّهِ، لِلشَّمْسِ، لِلصّائِمينَ.

Whether the connecting hamza is pronounced or not, and whether its vowel is kasra, fatḥa or ḍamma, it is written without a hamza as an alif only (ا): اسْم (not إسم), امْرَأَة, ادْخُلْ (not أُدْخُلْ). After the prepositional lām the alif of ال is not written: لِلَّهِ، لِلشَّمْسِ، لِلصّائِمينَ.
